note: REFERENCE, not an ExperimentConfig. This is the complete 2.2.0 scoring configuration as ScoringConfig.DEFAULT must expose it. It is not hashed and not a variant: the control is s0-control, whose strategy_inputs are empty (variant_id 44136fa355b3678a). Two objects describing the same behaviour must not both carry a variant id.
acceptance: backtest.cli identity --run replay-9ec9cd4487f3ba19 must report 0 mismatches over 886954 ledger rows with this table loaded as the default.

weights._note: note name -> score contribution, per entry_mode. A note is the audit record of one term firing, so note names ARE component names; the decomposition in backtest/experiments/rescore.py depends on that identity.

arms._note: Components with an else-branch. Both arms are independent notes, so an override that touches one and not the other is legal but is almost always a mistake - zeroing `sweep` while keeping `weak_sweep` leaves a pure penalty with no bonus.

rr.below_floor_action: SKIP with reason bad_rr, before any tier is assigned
rr.band_note: the 1.5 band emits an rr_ note worth 0 - precedent for scoring a component at weight 0 while keeping its audit trail
rr.computed_in: score_signal, from entry_price/sl/tp; stamped onto RiskPlan.rr afterwards

post_scoring.quirk: the penalty lands on score_signal's SKIP results too, so a bad_rr SKIP in a choppy market publishes score -2

constants_on_this_corpus._note: Measured over 373723 scored ledger rows. A constant term cannot change any ranking or any tier while thresholds are unchanged, which is why these are KEPT rather than removed.
constants_on_this_corpus.weekly_aligned: fires on 373720/373723 - direction is derived from weekly_bias, so the term is a tautology
constants_on_this_corpus.displacement: constant in CONTINUATION (the mode gate awards it), variable in RETRACEMENT where it also gates the A+ tier

never_fires_on_this_corpus._note: 0 occurrences in 373723 scored rows (Phase A / A1). Reachable in code; simply never reached by this data. Zeroing the weight is corpus-safe AND keeps a future firing visible in the notes.
